column1: # universe.tsv — the CLI sampling universe for the j22 function survey.
# One row per end-user-visible CLI command.  The universe is the documented
# user-command surface: the union of the entries documented in
# below.  tests/python/test_survey_sample.py enforces the sync in BOTH
# directions (a documented command missing here, or a row naming something
# undocumented/absent from bin/, fails the suite) — additions to either
# exclusion table are deliberate, recorded decisions, never silent.
#   command   bin/ script name (invoked from the tree under test)
#   lab       minimum lab shape: single | two (two-node items force the
#             j05 lab; single items run in either lab shape)
#   node      guest the item runs on: storage | compute
#   depth     recipe depth, disclosed per item in the run report:
#             deep      full user flow against survey-owned scratch state
#                       (wrong or missing identifiers, usage, FATAL paths)
#   invoke    command string with {PLACEHOLDER} tokens resolved by the
#             means the bespoke recipe owns the whole invocation
#   profiles  comma list of response profiles that apply (the item's
#             archived profile picks the feed/rc row), or "-" when the
#   assert    extended regex the combined output must match, or "-"
#   {VMID}  101 (the j05 lab VM)  {VDISK} 9 (the survey scratch disk slot)
# EXCLUDED from the universe.  Every excluded DOCUMENTED command is listed
# below, one per line with its reason class — the drift test parses these
# lines, so the tables stay honest.  (Undocumented internal helpers need
# no row: only the documented surface is accounted for here.)
# misc — declared not worth testing (user decision 2026-10-26, the closed
#        list; viewer/reporter, acting-helper, sourced-helper, dev tools):
#        dedicated journeys own them: j01-j03 j05 j08-j10 j12 j19 j23-j25):
